headline: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Leans On Optum And Medicare Advantage, Is The Stock Already Pricey?
summary: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) is back in focus after fresh attention on its Medicare Advantage and Optum Health businesses, which are helping offset pressure in commercial insurance and shaping how investors interpret the stock’s recent moves.
